voice.sub: Welcome to BlueWind HORIZONS.
I am Eolus, the artificial intelligence of BlueWind Technology. I connect processes and people.
Eolus, what's the weather like today?
Good morning! Today in Pensacola it's sunny, 74 °F, with a light breeze. A perfect day for wind energy.
Any hurricane alerts for Pensacola?
No active alerts. Hurricane season ends on November 30th.
What time is sunset today?
Sunset today is at 4:52 PM.
Eolus, how is tomorrow's production?
Tomorrow, 6 nacelles are in the line. Nacelle N-105 is 2 days behind schedule. I recommend moving one team from Finishing to Lamination.
Schedule. Production. Alerts. Messages. Daily dashboard. History. And team. Everything in one place, live from the cloud.
I am connected to every system in the factory: Recruitment and safety training. Resin dosing. Gel coat and vacuum monitoring. The production line. And the factory screens.
Eolus, how is the factory today?

I checked the cameras. The infusion area is disorganized; it needs attention. In assembly, the WT20 nacelle is off the production rail. And in the parking lot, there is a car in the CEO's spot that is not the CEO's car.
Tyler, this is Eolus. Vacuum pump #3 is failing on the infusion line. Please check it now.
Safety alert! A worker is at height without a harness.
Mike, this is Eolus. A worker is on top of a wind turbine nacelle without a safety harness. Fall protection is required. Please act now.
Attention, BlueWind team. Our weekly Safety Meeting starts at 10:30, in the main hall. Please join us.
Caution! A pedestrian is in the forklift lane in Assembly. Forklift operator, please stop now.
Attention, team. The temperature in the plant is 96 °F. Please take a 10-minute water break and stay hydrated.
BlueWind. Connecting processes and people. The next phase starts now.
